settings.title: Settings - Breaksy
general.subtitle: Application information and updates.
general.autostart_desc: Opens Breaksy automatically when you sign in.
general.history_tip: Opens the Breaksy releases on GitHub
app.subtitle: How Breaksy warns and interrupts you when time is up.
app.voices_desc: The character speaks on every state change. If you turn it off, no voice lines are played.
app.sounds_desc: Plays sound effects that are not voices: the alarm when the break ends and the sounds for pausing, resuming and deactivating. If you turn it off, they stay silent.
app.show_state_desc: Shows the current status below the character.
app.show_timer_desc: Shows the remaining time below the character.
app.keyboard_warning: ⚠ Keyboard lock is not available on this computer. The Intermediate and Strict levels will work without locking the keyboard. Check the debug console to see why.
level.light_desc: The character changes state and warns you by voice. When time is up, the options window appears.
level.intermediate_desc: The character changes state and warns you by voice. When time is up, the options window appears and the keyboard is locked until the break ends.
level.strict_desc: The character changes state and warns you by voice. When time is up, the options window appears, the keyboard is locked until the break ends, and a warning window is shown in the center of the screen.
custom.subtitle: Change the character's images and voices.
custom.editor_desc: Add images and sounds to each state. If you add several, one is chosen at random.
custom.guide_desc: Explains which images and voices you can replace and when each one appears.
custom.folder_desc: Put your images and voices here. They take priority over the built-in ones and are kept when Breaksy updates.
dev.subtitle: Debugging and testing tools.
dev.console_desc: Shows the application's event log in a separate window.
update.press_check: Click "Check for updates" to see if there is a new version.
update.only_installed: Updates are only available in the installed version.
